description: This file defines a class `HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Multiple` which handles CSS properties that accept multiple values, such as border-width and margin. It manages validation, parsing, and constraining the number of values, typically up to four.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Multiple
